_comment: Template: Restore SHACL .ttl files from EA constraint CSV files (the EA Import Format export).
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar csv2shacl --config this-file.json
_note_csvFiles: EA constraint CSV files with a Payload column.
_note_outputDir: Folder for the restored .ttl files, one per SourceFile. Files of the same name are replaced.
